description: This Java class implements a cache-aware DAO for managing latest time series data in a Thingsboard server, utilizing Redis cache and SQL backend.

classes.name: CachedRedisSqlTimeseriesLatestDao
classes.description: A cache-aware DAO implementation for latest time series data, integrating Redis cache with SQL backend.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes cache counters and logs DAO startup.

methods.name: saveLatest
methods.description: Saves latest time series data, updates cache, and logs operation.

methods.name: removeLatest
methods.description: Removes latest data, updates cache accordingly, and logs operation.

methods.name: findLatestOpt
methods.description: Retrieves latest data optionally, with cache lookup.

methods.name: findLatest
methods.description: Retrieves latest data, wrapping nulls, with cache support.

methods.name: doFindLatest
methods.description: Performs cache lookup for latest data, falls back to DAO if cache miss.

methods.name: findAllLatest
methods.description: Retrieves all latest data for an entity.

methods.name: findAllKeysByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Finds all keys associated with a device profile.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIds
methods.description: Finds all keys for given entity IDs.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds all keys for given entity IDs.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIds
methods.description: Finds latest entries for multiple entity IDs.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds latest entries for multiple entity IDs.
